//: V16 §8 — CONTROLLED extension of the EXISTING Radar (no second radar): a versioned research-governor grant scoped to Claude Code and its ecosystem. Same canonical shape as V372, plus two V16 opt-ins enforced by research-governor.govern(): hostMatch:"EXACT" (governor agrees with bounded-http-client's exact-host allowlist; https required) and allowedPaths (per-host path prefixes, segment-boundary match). The canonical bounded-http-client ALLOWLIST is NOT mutated: allowedDomains are passed as the per-call allowlist (V138 pattern). Live egress additionally requires ODG_RADAR_LIVE=1 (kill-switch) — owner-gated; this file alone performs no egress.

grant.issuedBy: owner (V16 §8 directive — prepare a controlled Radar allowlist extension for Claude Code research; live activation = owner sets ODG_RADAR_LIVE=1)
grant.expiryNote: 29 days (≤ 30-day ceiling). Not renewable in place: renewal = a new versioned grant file.
grant.scope: READ_ONLY_PUBLIC_RESEARCH — official, public, unauthenticated Claude Code documentation, Anthropic engineering articles and the public anthropics/claude-code repository metadata
grant.allowedDomainsNote: Minimal official set. Exact hosts only (no sub-domain). docs.anthropic.com and docs.claude.com are deliberately NOT included: Claude Code documentation is served from code.claude.com and those hosts are expected to answer with redirects, which bounded-http-client blocks (REDIRECT_BLOCKED) — this expectation is UNVERIFIED (no live fetch was run when preparing this grant). api.github.com is already in the canonical client ALLOWLIST; here it is further bounded to the anthropics/claude-code repository path. Any addition = new versioned commit with a justification line in domainAdditions[].
grant.transport: HTTPS only (bounded-http-client.get — GET only, redirects blocked, SSRF guard, size cap, timeout)

budget.quotaScope: PER RUN — enforced in code by research-budget.governWithBudget (requireBudget) with usage starting at 0 for each run; a cumulative cap across runs is NOT enforced in code (each live run must be recorded and pinned in docs/odg/evidence/COLLECTION_REGISTRY.json)

grant.contentPolicy: fetched content is untrusted data; never executed; findings evaluated before integration

enforcement.policy: runtime/core/research-governor.ts govern() — authorized + unexpired + EXACT host + path prefix (deny-by-default)
enforcement.transport: runtime/core/bounded-http-client.ts — validateUrl (exact-host per-call allowlist), ODG_RADAR_LIVE kill-switch, REDIRECT_BLOCKED, per-call contentTypes
enforcement.content: runtime/core/frontier-radar.ts sanitizeExternal() via research-governor.stampFinding() — injection ⇒ QUARANTINE (HYPOTHESIS)
enforcement.provenance: each live run records url/status/bytes/sha256 and must be pinned in docs/odg/evidence/COLLECTION_REGISTRY.json before any finding is reused

constraints: no private credentials, no authentication, no account creation, no GitHub token
no external writes, no form submission, no side effect on any third party
no paid API, no purchase, no subscription
no circumvention of access controls (HTTP 401/403/429 recorded, never bypassed); respect robots/terms
no secret transmitted in any request
fetched content is never executed, never treated as instructions; discovery ≠ authorization (proposals stay PROPOSED)
reuse recorded results before any new collection
